COLLABORATIVE PRODUCTIVITY

/ 01

MultiTasked

A shared place to keep the work moving.

Shared task boards that bring people, plans, and everyday lists together. Built for Android with real-time Firebase updates.

Built withKotlin · Jetpack Compose · Firebase Auth · Firestore · Coroutines

Inside the build

MultiTasked is a collaborative Android task manager for shared projects and everyday life. I built the app around boards that people can create, share, and join, with a dedicated grocery mode for tracking the cost of a list.

  • Create and join shared boards with unique IDs
  • Add notes, due dates, priorities, and assignees
  • Track task completion with progress indicators
  • Use grocery mode for item prices and running totals
  • Search and organize boards across multiple projects

Kotlin and Jetpack Compose power the interface, while Coroutines and Firebase support real-time cloud updates. Shared-list IDs and Android deep links connect invitations to the right in-app destination.

LEARNING & EXAM PREP

/ 02

CertMaster

A study routine that goes wherever you do.

A mobile study platform for 30+ trade certifications, with practice quizzes, timed exams, flashcards, and progress tracking.

Built withKotlin · Firebase · Firestore · Question-bank tooling

Inside the build

CertMaster brings multiple trade-certification study paths into one Android app. It gives learners different ways to review, practice, and track their performance, from a short quiz to a timed exam.

  • Switch between 30+ trade-certification study categories
  • Practice with multiple-choice quizzes and timed exams
  • Review material with flashcards
  • See challenging questions and quiz accuracy
  • Track daily study streaks and answer milestones

I built data-seeding utilities to populate and validate multi-category question banks. Firebase Firestore supports indexed queries and local offline caching. The app also includes premium-access and subscription-management workflows.

SHARED HEALTH & HABITS

/ 03

LetsFit

Two people. Shared progress.
A little more accountability.

A two-person health app that uses the Gemini API to scan food photos and return estimated nutrition values, alongside manual logs and shared cravings.

Built withKotlin · Jetpack Compose · MVVM · StateFlow · Gemini API · JSONBin · Health Connect

Inside the build

LetsFit brings two people together to track nutrition and build healthier routines. It implements the Gemini API to analyze captured food photos and return estimated calories, protein, carbohydrates, and fat. Previously called DuoTrack, it also includes manual meal logging, partner dashboards, and a shared cheat-day hub.

  • Take food photos and scan them with the Gemini API
  • Receive estimated calories, protein, carbohydrates, and fat
  • Switch between your dashboard and a partner's
  • Log and edit meals, calories, and macronutrients
  • Record food-related acid-risk ratings
  • Collect cravings in a shared list and decision wheel
  • Access a progress screen for weight and active calories

Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and an MVVM architecture with StateFlow. The Gemini API processes captured food photos and returns estimated nutrition values for meal tracking. Users can also enter or edit meals manually. JSONBin supports the multi-device synchronization design, while Android Health Connect provides the integration path for weight and active calories.

The screenshots show local demo mode. Live multi-device synchronization requires JSONBin configuration, and Health Connect data requires user permission.
